c: On an active incident, choose the Agent Assist icon in the side panel.
say: On an active incident, open the Agent Assist icon in the side panel.

c: The search uses the incident's Short description. Change the words if they don't find what you need.
say: Agent Assist searches with the incident's short description. Change the words if they don't find what you need.

c: Pick a source: Knowledge & Catalog, Outages, Incidents, Open Incidents or Resolved Incidents.
say: Pick where to look: knowledge and catalog, outages, recent incidents, open incidents or resolved incidents.

c: On an article, Attach it; on an incident, Link to Incident or Copy Resolution; on an item, Order.
say: On an article, attach it. On an incident, link to it as the parent, or copy its resolution. On a catalog item, order it.

c: Copy Resolution fills Resolution code and Resolution notes on the form. Check them, then Save the incident.
say: Copy resolution fills the resolution code and notes on the form. Check them, then save the incident.

c: The Recommendations icon is there too, but on pdi2 it finds nothing: its only active source is AI Search, which is switched off.
say: The recommendations icon is there too, but on pdi2 it finds nothing. Its only active source is AI search, which is switched off.
